name: budget-overview
before: [...document.querySelectorAll('#connection button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Connect').click(); 'connected to the mock laser'
after: (() => { const shown = (el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== 'hidden'; }; const page = [...document.querySelectorAll('main.page')].find(shown); const frame = [...document.querySelectorAll('#status, #tabs')]; const n = (root, sel) => [...root.querySelectorAll(sel)].filter(shown).length; const both = (sel) => n(page, sel) + frame.reduce((a, c) => a + n(c, sel), 0); const controls = both('button') + both('input:not([type=hidden]), select, textarea'); const words = (page.innerText || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length; const panels = [...page.querySelectorAll('.panel')].filter(shown).length; return { controls, words, panels }; })()
